model: Claude Fable 5.2, answering the fact sheets in a chat session (not through the API)

1.note: All 3 "was" are one verb in one form: {r3}, {r9} and {r15}. The form is the imperfect, used for ongoing action in the past.

3.note: One verb comes 3 times: {r4}, {r8} and {r12}. The first two are aorist, the action seen as a whole, while the last is perfect: a finished action whose result still stands.

6.note: "There came" is {r1}, the same verb shown as "came into being" in verse 3, "made" in verse 10 and "become" in verses 12 and 14.

19.note: "Testimony" is {r5}, the same word shown as "witness" in verse 7.

33.note: "Baptize" comes twice: {r9} is the "to …" form, and {r29} is a participle, an "-ing" form, where the Berean text has "will baptize".

38.note: "Staying" is {r23}, the same verb shown as "remained" in verses 32 and 33. "Which means" is {r19}, a passive form of the verb for "said".

39.note: "Come" and "went" are one verb, {r3} and {r6}: a command, then the aorist. "See" and "saw" are another, {r5} and {r9}: the future, then the aorist.

41.note: "First" is {r3}, the same word shown as "before" in verses 15 and 30. "Found" comes twice, {r1} and {r12}: the first is a present form, the second a perfect, a finished action whose result still stands.

42.note: "Looked at" is {r6}, the same verb shown as "saw" in verse 36.
